title: Data Engineer / MLOps
description: Verrastack is building data pipelines that feed our internal ML and semantic search products. We're looking for a data engineer comfortable owning Python pipelines end-to-end, from ingestion through to serving embeddings for retrieval, deployed on AWS.
requirements: Strong Python skills for building and maintaining data pipelines
Experience with vector search / embedding-based retrieval (sentence-transformers or similar)
Experience with hybrid search approaches combining keyword and semantic search
Experience with PostgreSQL, ideally with pgvector
Experience deploying pipelines on AWS (S3, and container-based compute)
Comfortable with Docker and CI/CD pipelines
nice_to_have: Experience integrating LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar) into pipelines
Experience with Redis for caching pipeline intermediate results
